posts.title: Patterns
posts.description: I did a lot of little projects when I started programming. Small websites that explored a concept. They were simple, they were meaningless, and most importantly, they were fun. I miss that. I need to start this again. Pattern is a first step: A simple 320x320px grid, for everyone to write to by picking their favorite color. Try it. Pattern

posts.title: Fun with Yubikeys: Hardware-Backed Kubernetes Auth
posts.description: The private key that grants admin access to your Kubernetes cluster shouldn’t live in ~/.kube/config . It shouldn’t live on your filesystem at all. I built a proxy that keeps my k8s client credentials locked inside a YubiKey . TL;DR: If you just want the tool: yubikey-kube-proxy . Read on for how it works.
